title: The Guardian
description:
S1
Yuppies (Dwier Brown, Carey Lowell) with a baby hire a nanny (Jenny Seagrove), a druid witch who sacrifices babies to a tree.

title: I Saw What You Did
description:
S1
Two teenage girls, bored while baby-sitting, make prank phone calls, completely unaware one of the people on the other end of the line has just killed his wife and now thinks the girls must be silenced.

title: Incarnate
description:
S1
Recruited by a Vatican emissary (Catalina Sandino Moreno), an exorcist (Aaron Eckhart) taps into the subconscious mind of a tormented boy (David Mazouz) to free him from demonic possession.

title: The Keeping Hours
description:
S1
A lawyer sees the ghost of his dead son, which leads the man's estranged wife back into his life.

title: Killer High
description:
S1
Sabrina's perfectly planned high school reunion goes south when a monster keeps killing all the guests.

title: Boogeyman
description:
S1
Mike (Eddie McClintock), the town sheriff, has to battle the mythical Boogeyman after boys accidentally release it.

title: Long Time Dead
description:
S1
A genie terrorizes London students (Lara Belmont, Melanie Gutteridge) after they unwittingly summon it with a Ouija.

title: The New Daughter
description:
S1
A single father (Kevin Costner) is puzzled by his daughter's (Ivana Baquero) weird behavior, which begins soon after he moves his family to a secluded woodland home.

title: Nightmare
description:
S1
A guardian (David Knight) and his lover (Moira Redmond) stage grim scenes to drive a haunted English heiress (Jennie Linden) mad.

title: Rosewood Lane
description:
S1
Sonny Blake (Rose McGowan), a radio talk show therapist, moves back to her childhood home after her father dies. She is shocked to learn her neighbors are terrified of the paperboy (Daniel Ross Owens) who turns out to be a dangerous sociopath.
